title: PET on the Heisenberg lift keeps the floor-correction as a coordinate
statement: The first van der Corput / PET difference of the floor-Hardy Heisenberg orbit g(n) = ((3/2) v^{3/4}, v^{3/2}, 0), v = floor(n^{3/2}), keeps the floor-removal correction as a Mal'cev coordinate through reduction to the fundamental domain and does not re-expand it into an amplitude-product of GG/HH species.
mathematical_domain: Juggler parity discrepancy / nilmanifold characteristic factors
tested_range: exact Fraction group-law identities; scaled-integer species on odd pairs in (10^4, 10^4+200] and (10^6, 10^6+200]
counterexamples: Mal'cev reduction of g(n)^{-1} g(n+h) has vertical {-A(n+h) floor(ΔB) - A(n){ΔB}}; the second term is the amplitude-product A{ΔB}
ΔB is not o(1)-close to (n+h)^{9/4}-n^{9/4}: leftover ≍ n^{3/4}
re-lifting A{ΔB} as the vertical of (A(n), ΔB(n,h), 0) is J-tower-heisenberg-coordinate applied to a new pair, not a degree drop to a published Hardy-nil orbit
notes: Fourth-layer falsifier of the rate-free nil-route, opened from the v94 CLOSE (characteristic factors had been left external). Kills PET as a method. The statement of juggler_tower_rate_free_equidistribution stays ACTIVE: Leibman/Richter on the floor-Hardy horizontal remains the unbuilt composition, and the node-wise E-share β>0.369 fallback is not opened. Not a K3 bound, not a Paper B edit, not a halt theorem.
